description: Add an ExUnit resume-correctness test: kernels covering loop shapes (array generator + filter + nested range, loop in if-branch, 3-deep with flat siblings, long strip loops, fuzzy_search Levenshtein) must match their yield: false twins, both with natural yields and with a yield forced at every clock read. Needs a per-module __defk_force_yields__/1 NIF hook. Follow-up to defk-nua.
title: Add resume stress test (forced yields)
